about: Verth scam-check test set, written 11 October 2026, before the checker was run on it. Scam messages are modelled on common scams reported in India; genuine messages are the kind of real messages people get, including ones that look alarming. Names, numbers and links are made up. The checker was not changed after seeing these results.
